name: Ben Day
description: A comic page of square panels in heavy black frames, each panel filled with a Ben-Day dot screen of small, medium or large dots, a line screen or flat color.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @p(@var(--sc0), @var(--sc1), @var(--sc1), @var(--sc2), @var(--sc2), @var(--sc3), @var(--sc4)); mask: @p(@var(--sc0), @var(--sc1), @var(--sc1), @var(--sc2), @var(--sc2), @var(--sc3), @var(--sc4)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; background: @p(var(--color1)); -webkit-mask: @var(--frame); mask: @var(--frame); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --sc0: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 42%, transparent 42%) 0 0 / 12.5% 12.5%, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 42%, transparent 42%) 7.1429% 7.1429% / 12.5% 12.5%; --sc1: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 60%, transparent 60%) 0 0 / 12.5% 12.5%, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 60%, transparent 60%) 7.1429% 7.1429% / 12.5% 12.5%; --sc2: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 78%, transparent 78%) 0 0 / 12.5% 12.5%, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 78%, transparent 78%) 7.1429% 7.1429% / 12.5% 12.5%; --sc3: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 3.4%, transparent 3.4% 8.33%); --sc4: linear-gradient(#000, #000); --frame: linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0 0 / 100% 5% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0 100% / 100% 5% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0 0 / 5% 100% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 100% 0 / 5% 100% no-repeat; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
